name: Projects Pending Approval
query:
SELECT 
    name as "project_id:Link/Project:150",
    project_name as "project_name::200",
    custom_approval_status as "status:data:100",
    custom_created_from_daily_work_allocation as "from_allocation:Link/Daily Work Allocation:180",
    owner as "created_by::120",
    creation as "created_on:Datetime:150"
FROM tabProject 
WHERE custom_approval_status = 'Draft'
ORDER BY creation DESC
